title: Bir Aslan Büyüyor
author: Öznur Karaeloğlu
description: Tori lives in the Great Forest with his parents and loves playing with friends. One day, while playing with a rabbit, Tori finds himself in the middle of a huge adventure. The story follows a curious lion cub’s journey toward becoming the leader of the forest and emphasizes the importance of family and awareness of one’s responsibilities.
